svg.title: WEFT-1 recurrent bicameral language model: target architecture and current construction state
svg.desc: A full-page architecture diagram showing the ratified WEFT-1 target dataflow, the current executable AblationLM path, standalone tested components, absent or open components, PF-3 evidence, and five unresolved decisions including Catch 35.
svg.text: Ratified target architecture, overlaid with what is actually constructed today
Status means code reachability - not scientific validation.
d=1024 · head=64 · GQA 16Q/8KV · FFN=2816 · disagreement rank=32 · scratch=2x256
K curriculum 1→2→4; max 8 · residual scale αK=c/K · context 2048→4096 · tied V pending G-TOK
E x d router μP class unbound
Full-width causal carrier; target recurrence transforms it through
core residuals, orthogonal rotors, and bounded callosal mixing;
one rank-8 lane write; optional arms retain structural OFF.
SHARED RECURRENT LOOM · repeat k = 1…K over C unique core blocks
reuse across K; no K multiplier
Q K V O gate up down: stored (μ, δ=UVᵀ)
Dense FFN is executable; target sequency expert alternative + fixed occupancy router is absent.
Rotor-QK J_att=2 and T12 parameter/FLOP-matched dense control are also not built.
plus one residual rank-8 lane write / hemi
primitive and closed-form T16 pass; not in forward
next visit; same unique weights; caller-owned cache reused (production representation open)
prior scratch + causal h_A/h_B + engram values → position-local update
current narrow two-lane Birkhoff mixer is integrated; it is not the full-width callosum
lanes persist across visits and never read a future token directly
fires on trajectory pivot; writes lanes only
target: pooled-lane jet + learned probes; controllers absent
HIDDEN JET NOW · POOLED-LANE TARGET OPEN
per-visit combine → shared coda for step logits / L_stage (both unbuilt)
final path now · per-visit decode target
CE + z-loss; V freezes only after G-TOK
WHAT ACTUALLY RUNS IN AblationLM.forward TODAY
A causally tested single-stream recurrent bring-up graph. Optional green modules remain independently switchable.
* Optional. With every optional arm structurally OFF, the registered CPU anchor is bit-identical to the plain dense transformer.
paired core/seam · learned rotor/write · per-band callosum · final combine · bridge_out · sidecar.
The target 9/4/9 and 8/6/8 constructors exist; this green path is not yet the integrated full-width bicameral production model.
OPEN QUESTIONS THAT BLOCK THE NEXT INTEGRATION
Ratify the unit-circle final combiner, or bind another exact map + init.
Paired-eigenmode K/V, or shared-consensus cache without K/V disagreement?
Lane-native sidecar, or exact full-width lift/project maps + accounting?
Bind STE, τ, initial eligible firing rate, and calibration/freeze rule.
Classify E×d Hadamard router init/LR/decay, or change topology.
Run-axis still pending: P-A/P-B → G-TOK vocabulary freeze. No model training result exists.
